svg.title: Lucas N. Munhoz: building productivity & language learning tools, Bangkok, Thailand
svg.desc: A Bangkok, Thailand skyline where each building is one week of GitHub contributions over the past year. 2,846 contributions in total; the busiest week, starting 2026-11-08, had 753.
